hero.description: An independent look at how the Ministry of Interior's services moved from the counter to the screen, and where the transformation is heading next.

journey.heading: The Journey
journey.intro: Seven pages follow the story from the national vision to the technology shaping what comes next.

steps.teaser: The national blueprint and the three pillars behind the transformation.
A timeline from an early administrative authority to today's digital ministry.
The Ministry's e-services platform and how it has grown.
How one verified identity opens government and private services.
Unified platforms and AI in public security, with what is operating and what is planned.
Recent services that moved from the counter to the screen.
The 2030 roadmap, global rankings, and announced next steps.

about.heading: About This Project
about.text: MOI Digital Evolution is an educational project. Every figure on the site carries its source and date, and announced plans are clearly separated from services that are already operating.
